meta.task_text: Design a battery for a smartphone: volumetric energy density >= 950 Wh/L, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 50 C, anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 cycles, voltage plateau >= 4.1 V.
meta.mode: headless zero-interaction (no clarification; parsed from task text, defaults for unspecified)
meta.start_stage_basis: task text names no electrode system (anchor-table default Chen2020, recorded), but voltage plateau >= 4.1 V is unreachable by NMC811-class cathodes (anchor: NMC811 cell midpoint 3.61 V) -> objective involves new-material design (high-voltage cathode system switch) -> start at Stage 2 with a system candidate (system candidates skip the molecular funnel, direct Stage 3 evaluation)
meta.base_mapping: no explicit electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (recorded); plateau >= 4.1 V -> high-voltage LNMO library parameter set scripts/bda/simulators/data/LNMO.json (4.7 V-class spinel cathode; runner merges Chen2020 base + JSON overrides). Discriminant verified by dump: lnmo_ocp numeric sweep (bulk plateau ~4.40-4.45 V vs NMC811 midpoint 3.61 V); note: several LNMO.json keys use newer-style names that the installed pybamm 26.7.1 Chen2020 set does not read (max concentration / molar mass / stoich limits remain Chen2020 values) - recorded honestly, effective set behavior judged by simulation output only

electrode_system.basis: task names no system; plateau >= 4.1 V requires a high-voltage cathode -> system switch allowed (widest interpretation)

electrolyte_formulation.basis: not declared in task text -> widest interpretation (t1_r1 lesson)

electrode_modification.basis: not declared in task text -> widest interpretation

cell_architecture.basis: not declared in task text -> widest interpretation

thermal_management.basis: not declared in task text -> widest interpretation (cooling h; contract default 10 W/m2K)

excluded_levers: solid-phase conductivity / solid-phase diffusivity (no formulation/doping mapping model)
charge cut-off voltage (usage mode, not design)

threshold_parsing.volumetric energy density >= 950 Wh/L: criteria.stage2.energy_density_wh_l {min: 950} <- calc-energy energy_density_wh_l (contract formula, electrolyte excluded)
threshold_parsing.voltage plateau >= 4.1 V: criteria.stage2.midpoint_voltage_v {min: 4.1} <- calc-energy midpoint_voltage_v (plateau-voltage approximation = voltage at discharge-time midpoint)
threshold_parsing.anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100: criteria.stage2.sei_thickness_nm_end {max: 500} <- run-pyamm aging_1C_100cyc (100x 1C CC charge/discharge, SEI ec reaction limited, isothermal)
threshold_parsing.maximum temperature <= 50 C: criteria.stage3.T_max_K {max: 323.15} (50 C = 323.15 K) <- run-pyamm 4C_charge_45C --thermal lumped (skill-defined fast-charge safety exam at 45 C ambient)
